title: The IDF field hospital in the Philippines delivered a baby, and his parents named him Israel

trailer.text: The IDF, the Israeli army, sent a search, rescue and medical delegation to the Philippines after super-typhoon Haiyan killed thousands of people there.
The delegation set up a field hospital in the city of Bogo on Cebu Island.
On the day the hospital opened, Israeli army medics delivered a baby there.
His parents named him Israel, in gratitude to the volunteers.
According to JTA, at least 12 babies were born in the Israeli field hospital, most of them premature, and one of them was named Israel.

glance.label: Where
glance.value: Bogo City, Cebu Island, the Philippines

paragraphs.text: Super-typhoon Haiyan, also called Yolanda in the Philippines, killed thousands of people and left the country in a humanitarian crisis.
According to Rappler, it was the world's strongest typhoon to make landfall.
The city of Bogo in Cebu province was among the hardest-hit cities.
According to JTA, nearly 2 million people were displaced from their homes.
At least 37 countries began assisting the Philippines.
The IDF sent a search, rescue and medical delegation to the Philippines.
It included members of the IDF Home Front Command.
The mission was called "Operation Islands for Hope".
According to JTA, the delegation landed on Thursday evening in Bogo City on Cebu Island.
The team brought more than 100 tons of humanitarian and medical supplies from Israel.
They included wheelchairs, ultrasound machines, diapers, medication and even refrigerators.
According to JNS, the team worked in coordination with Shaare Zedek Medical Center in Jerusalem.
The team included doctors, nurses, paramedics, pharmacists, mental health professionals, X-ray technicians and lab workers.
Home Front Command personnel coordinated the logistics.
One of the logistics officers left for the Philippines two days after his wedding, although he was on leave from the army for the occasion.
Lt. Col. Dr. Ofer Merin, the medical manager of the field hospital, was at the time a cardiac surgeon and deputy director of Shaare Zedek.
According to him, the IDF mobilizes quickly because it operates as an army unit and sends an advance team.
The Israeli team was one of 11 foreign medical teams operating in the affected regions.
According to JTA, the field hospital began operating on Friday morning, about seven hours after the team arrived on the island.
It was set up next to the local hospital in Bogo City.
According to Merin, the Israeli field hospital was the only one in a region of about 250,000 residents.
The team worked in large green tents.
They contained an X-ray room, a children's department, an ambulatory care department and birthing facilities.
The IDF also brought incubators for premature babies.
According to the IDF Spokesperson, the hospital could treat 500 people at a time.
The facility ran on generators, so it closed at 18:00 to conserve energy.
The Israeli doctors also operated in the local hospital, together with local doctors.
According to the Inquirer, the mother, the barangay treasurer of San Vicente, was busy distributing relief when she went into labor.
She rushed to the field hospital to get a referral to a hospital in Cebu City.
Instead of a referral, the Israeli team assured her a safe delivery in the tent.
The baby was born in a natural delivery, ahead of term.
According to Dr. Reuven Keidar, a healthy boy was born.
According to the Israeli Embassy statement, Keidar held the baby in his arms and congratulated the parents in Hebrew: Mazel tov.
According to the Inquirer, the father said that if the baby came out healthy, he would be named Israel.
According to JTA, the parents named him Israel in gratitude to the volunteers.
According to Adam Levene, deputy head of mission at the Israeli Embassy, the parents chose the name, and mother and baby are doing well.
The couple had hoped for a girl, because they already have two boys, aged 6 and 8, but they consider the baby a blessing.
The next day, on Saturday morning, the doctors delivered another baby by caesarean section.
IDF medics also delivered a premature baby at 34 weeks who was in distress.
According to JTA, at least 12 babies were born in the Israeli field hospital, most of them premature, and one of them was named Israel.
The premature babies were cared for in incubators the IDF had brought.
The team treated typhoon casualties and chronically ill people who could not care for themselves, because there was no running water or electricity.
Treatment ranged from colds to cancer diagnoses.
According to Rappler, IDF personnel treated thousands of wounded, most of them women and children.
According to the Jewish Press, one in every three patients was a child.
According to Levene, some of the patients were victims of the magnitude 7.2 earthquake in October.
Herminia Pruno, 57, came for a blood pressure and diabetes check.
She said she was happy to receive free medication.
Israeli doctors worked to restore the eyesight of a 70-year-old man whose eye was struck by a nail during the typhoon.
This was the team's first ophthalmology case.
At about 4 a.m. on Sunday, friends brought a man who had been stabbed in the chest to the hospital.
The doctors inserted a chest drain, which according to Merin was beyond the capabilities of the local hospital.
According to the mayor of Bogo, the hospital would serve all of northern Cebu, not only the nearby towns.

stations.title: What remained, and what was said

paragraphs.text: According to Merin, the team was expected to stay about two weeks, depending on the needs of the local population.
According to the Inquirer, the supplies, medicines and some of the equipment would be handed over to the Severo Verallo District Hospital in Bogo.
Merin said the operation cost Israel millions of dollars, as well as lost manpower.
According to him, the Israelis are ready to leave everything and come to help anywhere in the world where they are needed.
According to AP, the operation followed similar Israeli relief operations in Haiti in 2010 and in Turkey in 2011.
John Ging, a senior UN humanitarian official, said the field hospital capacity Israel mobilizes is top class.
According to him, this has been seen very effectively in many other crises.
Defense Minister Moshe Ya'alon spoke on Friday with his Filipino counterpart, Voltaire Gazmin.

claims.text: לפי אינקווירר, מאז יום שישי בית החולים הישראלי טיפל בכ-150 מטופלים ביום, ממחלות הצטננות ועד אבחון סרטן.
claims.quote: Since Friday, the Israeli hospital has served about 150 patients a day, attending to cases from the common cold to diagnosing cancer.

claims.text: לפי ראפלר, יותר מ-150 אנשי צה"ל, רופאים, מנתחים, אחיות וצוותי חילוץ, פעלו בבוגו וטיפלו באלפי פצועים ששרדו, רובם נשים וילדים.
claims.quote: There are over 150 personnel of the IDF in Bogo, including doctors, surgeons, nurses and rescue teams. They are treating thousands of wounded survivors, mostly women and children.

claims.text: לפי ג'ואיש פרס, אחד מכל שלושה פיליפינים שטופלו על ידי צה"ל מאז הגעת הצוות בן 148 החברים היה ילד.
claims.quote: One of every three Filipinos treated by the IDF since the 148-member team of officers and soldiers arrived last week has been a child

claims.text: לפי לווין, חלק מהמטופלים של צה"ל היו קורבנות רעידת האדמה בעוצמה 7.2 באוקטובר.
claims.quote: Levene said some of the patients the IDF was treating were victims of the magnitude 7.2 earthquake in October.

claims.text: לפי אינקווירר, הרמיניה פרונו בת 57 הגיעה לבדיקת לחץ דם וסוכרת ואמרה שהיא שמחה לקבל תרופות בחינם.
claims.quote: I am happy because I can ask for free medication here

claims.text: לפי AP, רופאים ישראלים פעלו להשבת הראייה לגבר בן 70 שמסמר פגע בעינו בזמן הטייפון, המקרה האופתלמולוגי הראשון של הצוות.
claims.quote: Israeli doctors are now working on restoring a 70-year-old man's eyesight after he was struck by a nail in the eye during the typhoon

claims.text: לפי JTA, בסביבות 4 לפנות בוקר ביום ראשון הובא לבית החולים השדה על ידי חבריו גבר שנדקר בחזהו.
claims.quote: At about 4 a.m. Sunday, a man who had been stabbed in the chest was brought to the Bogo City field hospital by friends.

claims.text: לפי JTA, הרופאים הכניסו לנדקר נקז חזה, שלדברי מרין היה מעבר ליכולות בית החולים המקומי.
claims.quote: Doctors put in a chest drain, which Merin says was beyond the capabilities of the local hospital.

claims.text: לפי ראש עיריית בוגו, בית החולים ישרת לא רק את הערים הסמוכות אלא את צפון סבו כולה.
claims.quote: This hospital will not only cater to nearby towns, it will cater to the whole northern Cebu

claims.text: לפי JTA, בהתאם למרין, הצוות צפוי להישאר כשבועיים, בהתאם לצורכי האוכלוסייה המקומית.
claims.quote: The team will likely stay for two weeks, though this will depend on what the needs of the local population

claims.text: לפי אינקווירר, הקבוצה הרפואית תשאיר בעזיבתה אספקה רפואית, תרופות וחלק מהציוד לבית החולים המחוזי סברו ורלו בבוגו.
claims.quote: The medical group will leave behind medical supplies, medicines and some equipment to the Severo Verallo Memorial District Hospital in Bogo city when they leave.

claims.text: לפי מרין ב-JTA, גיוס בית החולים השדה והפעלתו עלו לישראל מיליוני דולרים וכן אובדן כוח אדם.
claims.quote: Mobilizing and operating the field hospital has cost Israel millions of dollars, Merin says, as well as lost manpower.

claims.text: לפי מרין ב-JTA, הישראלים מוכנים להפקיר הכול ולבוא לסייע בכל מקום בעולם שבו יזדקקו להם.
claims.quote: ready to drop everything and come and assist anywhere in the world that we need to be

claims.text: לפי AP, התגובה הישראלית לאסון בפיליפינים באה בהמשך למבצעי סיוע דומים של ישראל בהאיטי ב-2010 ובטורקיה ב-2011.
claims.quote: Israel's response to the disaster in the Philippines follows similar relief operations the country mounted in Haiti in 2010 and Turkey in 2011.

claims.text: שר הביטחון משה יעלון שוחח ביום שישי עם מקבילו הפיליפיני וולטייר גזמין.
claims.quote: Defense Minister Moshe Ya'alon spoke with his Filipino counterpart, Voltaire Gazmin, on Friday

claims.text: לפי ישראל נשיונל ניוז, הודעת האו"ם ביום חמישי קבעה את מספר ההרוגים בטייפון על 4,460 ואת מספר העקורים על 920,000.
claims.quote: A statement by the UN on Thursday placed the typhoon's death toll at 4,460, with 920,000 people displaced by the storm.

claims.text: לפי ישראל נשיונל ניוז, בית החולים השדה כולל חדרי רנטגן ולידה ויכול לקלוט 500 מטופלים ביום.
claims.quote: The field hospital includes x-ray and delivery rooms, and is able to absorb 500 patients a day.

claims.text: לפי ג'רוזלם פוסט, התינוק הראשון שנולד בבית החולים השדה של צה"ל בפיליפינים נולד בשלום ביום שישי.
claims.quote: The first baby born at the Israeli Defense Forces field hospital in the Philippines was delivered safely on Friday.

claims.text: לפי הדיווח המהיר של ג'רוזלם פוסט, התינוק הראשון בבית החולים השדה של צה"ל בבוגו סיטי נולד ביום חמישי.
claims.quote: The first baby born at the Israeli Defense Forces field hospital in Bogo City in the Philippines was delivered safely on Thursday.

claims.text: לפי ישראל נשיונל ניוז, ראש עיריית בוגו סיטי, שבה הוקם בית החולים, הודיע שהתינוק ייקרא ישראל.
claims.quote: The mayor of Bogo City where the hospital was established announced the baby will be named

claims.text: סגן-אלוף ד"ר עופר מרין, המנהל הרפואי של בית החולים השדה, היה אז מנתח לב וסגן מנהל שערי צדק.
claims.quote: the recently appointed Director-General of Shaare Zedek Medical Center

claims.text: JTA: ביום שישי בבוקר, כשבע שעות אחרי שהצוות הגיע לאי
claims.quote: The field hospital began operating on Friday morning, about seven hours after the team arrived on the island.
